stateController.notes: EditHostedEventRouteScreen resolves uid, club, and event, handles loading/error/not-found/unauthorized route states, and delegates loaded state to EditHostedEventScreen. HostEventEditScreenState now owns loaded editability, schedule/policy lock derivation, field display state, save footer enabled/loading state, save error exposure, success/missing-location feedback copy, and pop-on-success policy. HostEventEditSaveRequest owns validated save payload construction. HostEventEditPrivateAccessState owns invite-only private-access watch and invite-code seed policy. HostEventEditFieldDisplayState owns schedule, location/details, and policy display values. EditHostedEventScreen still owns local form controllers, location picker navigation, validation, EventBookingController.updateHostedEventMutation execution, and Navigator/snackbar side effects.

composition.currentLayout: EditHostedEventRouteScreen owns provider loading/access through HostEventEditState. EditHostedEventScreen owns form controllers, validation, location picker navigation, mutation execution, snackbar, and Navigator side effects while HostEventEditScreenState owns loaded editability, schedule/policy locks, field display state, save footer state, save error display input, feedback copy, and pop-on-success policy; HostEventEditSaveRequest owns validated save payload construction; HostEventEditPrivateAccessState owns invite-only private-access watch and invite-code seed policy; HostEventEditFieldDisplayState owns schedule, location/details, and policy display values.
